display_name: 抖音评论导出 · 抖评岛
description_zh: 粘贴抖音视频链接，导出公开评论和楼中楼回复，保存为 CSV 或 Excel。也可先预览少量评论，分析用户反馈、产品问题和选题。中断后可继续原任务。需要 Node.js、抖评岛（ExportDou）账号和可用积分；回复和 Excel 功能以账号套餐权限为准。
description_en: Export public Douyin comments and replies to CSV or Excel. Preview a small sample for feedback analysis and resume interrupted exports. Requires Node.js, an ExportDou account and available credits. Replies and Excel depend on plan permissions.
author: Kenny Shaw
